Site information

About

Learn about Battery Atlas, an educational resource for understanding and comparing battery technologies.

Purpose

Battery Atlas is an educational resource explaining how primary batteries, rechargeable batteries and fuel cells work. Concept diagrams showing ion and electron movement, comparisons of benefits and limitations, and market data help readers understand electrochemistry.

Operator

Operated by Halmen. Technical and market information is organized into readable comparisons, with sources and limitations explained.

Source selection

We use publicly available material from the International Energy Agency (IEA), BloombergNEF, the U.S. Geological Survey (USGS), public institutions and manufacturers. BloombergNEF references are limited to publicly released summaries and announcements. We distinguish the reporting year, units, scope and reference date. Where figures cannot be compared on equivalent terms or information is unverified, we state those limitations.

IEABloombergNEFUSGS

How information is updated

The operator reviews new public sources and reported errors and makes corrections as needed. Changes to figures are checked against the relevant period and source. A reference date indicates when the underlying material was checked; a site modification date does not mean every statistic is current. Korean and English pages are updated together from the same source material.

Before using this information

This site provides educational information and does not guarantee the performance or safety of individual products or business returns. Before selecting a product, check the manufacturer’s latest specifications, operating conditions, certifications and safety requirements.
